nodes.name: β-Ni(OH)2 and doped variants hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: All chemical reagents were produced by Sinopharm Chemical Reagent Co., Ltd. In a typical procedure, 12 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O was dissolved in 40-mL deionized water and stirred for 15 min. The aqueous 0.6 M NaOH solution was added to the Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (0.3M) solution until the final pH of the mixed suspension was greater than 13. After stirring for 30 min, the Ni(OH)2 suspension was transferred to a 100-mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and maintained at 160°C for 6 h. The autoclave was cooled down naturally to room temperature. The β-Ni(OH)2 was washed with deionized water and anhydrous ethanol three times and dried at 60°C for 10 h. Finally, the β-Ni(OH)2 was obtained. In addition, the β-MxNi1-x(OH)y (M = Co, Mn, Fe) was synthesized using the same method.

nodes.name: β-Co(OH)2 hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.5 g CoCl2·6H2O was dissolved with 25-mL deionized water and stirred for 20 min. The aqueous 50-mL NaOH solution (1 M) was added to the CoCl2·6H2O solution and stirred for 30 min. After stirring, the Co(OH)2 suspension was transferred into a 100-mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and maintained at 100°C for 8 h. The autoclave was cooled down naturally to room temperature. The β-Co(OH)2 was washed with deionized water and anhydrous ethanol three times and dried at 60°C for 10 h, and then β-Co(OH)2 was obtained.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of β-Co(OH)2 ... and then β-Co(OH)2 was obtained.

nodes.name: β-Ni(OH)2/NF electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: 10 mmol Ni(NO3)2 and 5 mmol NH4NO3 were dissolved with 32-mL deionized water and stirred for 15 min. 18-mL ammonia (28 wt%) was dribbled into the mixed solution with vigorous stirring. After stirring for 15 min, the mixed solution was poured into a culture dish. The culture dish with solution was preheated at 90°C for 2 h. Then the clean NF was placed in the mixed solution and maintained at 90°C for 12 h. The β-Ni(OH)2/NF was washed with deionized water and anhydrous ethanol three times and dried at 60°C for 10 h. Finally, the β-Ni(OH)2/NF was obtained.

nodes.name: β-Co0.1Ni0.9(OH)2/NF electrodeposition
nodes.procedure: Using the same method as β-Ni(OH)2/NF but with appropriate Co precursor ratio.
nodes.source_text: In addition, the β-Co0.1Ni0.9(OH)2/NF was synthesized using the same method.

nodes.name: NiO calcination
nodes.procedure: Under Ar atmosphere, the β-Ni(OH)2 was heated at 300°C for 2 h in a tube furnace. Both heating and cooling rates were maintained at 5°C/min. Finally, the NiO was obtained.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of NiO and Co0.1Ni0.9O ... Finally, the NiO and the Co0.1Ni0.9O were obtained.

nodes.name: β-Ni0.9Al0.1(OH)2 hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.27 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O, 0.03 mmol Al(NO3)3·9H2O, 1.5 mmol urea, and 1 mmol NH4F were dissolved in 60-mL deionized water and stirred for 15 min. The suspension was transferred to a 100-mL Teflon-lined stainless-steel autoclave and maintained at 130°C for 6 h. The autoclave was cooled down naturally to room temperature. The β-Ni0.9Al0.1(OH)2 was washed with deionized water and anhydrous ethanol three times and dried at 60°C for 10 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: β-Ni(OH)₂ structures consist of regular hexagonal nanosheets with lateral sizes ranging from 30 to 60 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the TEM images, β-Ni(OH)₂ structures consisted of regular hexagonal nanosheets with lateral sizes ranging from 30 to 60 nm (Figure S8).

nodes.characterization_summary: O 1s XPS spectra show area ratio of oxygen with different ligand environments (H₂O, M-OH, and M-O) for β-Ni(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The area ratio of oxygen with different ligand environments (H₂O, M-OH, and M-O) of β-Ni(OH)₂... It was derived from the O 1s XPS spectra (Figure S7).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p XPS spectra show no obvious change and no Ni²⁺δ species after NOR for β-Ni(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ni 2p XPS spectra showed that after OER, the binding energy of Ni 2p peak was raised obviously due to Ni²⁺δ species; however, after NOR, Ni 2p peaks had no obvious change without Ni²⁺δ species (Figures S5 and S6).

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando EIS shows two equivalent circuit models for different potentials during OER and NOR with R₁ and R₂ resistance correlations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Operando EIS was used to study the potential-dependent interface behavior during OER or NOR... Optimum fit parameters for EIS data are shown in Tables S1–S3.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows peaks at 473 and 553 cm⁻¹ corresponding to Ni³⁺-O bending and stretching; Ni³⁺-O species accumulate after 1.60 V during NOR.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the Raman spectra, two peaks at 473 and 553 cm⁻¹ corresponded to Ni³⁺-O bending and stretching, respectively... Ni³⁺-O species only accumulated after 1.60 V during NOR (Figure 2B).

nodes.characterization_summary: TOF-SIMS spectra prove D of CD₃OD replaces hydrogen atom of β-Ni(OH)₂ during NOR.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TOF-SIMS spectra of β-Ni(OH)₂ electrode before and after NOR in 1 M KOH with 0.5 M CD₃OD prove that D of CD₃OD does replace hydrogen atom of β-Ni(OH)₂ during NOR.

nodes.characterization_summary: Detailed characterizations including XRD of β-Ni(OH)₂ are shown in Figures S1 and S2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: β-Ni(OH)₂ was synthesized via the hydrothermal method. The detailed characterizations are shown in Figures S1 and S2.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni K-edge in situ XANES spectra show Ni valence state changes during OER and NOR for β-Co₀.₁Ni₀.₉(OH)₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Ni K-edge in situ XANES spectra for β-Co₀.₁Ni₀.₉(OH)₂ during (E) OER (1 M KOH) and (F) NOR (1 M KOH with 0.5 M ethanol).

nodes.evidence_snippet: To avoid the influence of specific surface area, LSV polarization curves normalized by Brunauer, Emmett and Teller (BET) surface area are shown in Figure S32.

nodes.evidence_snippet: The structure and morphology of all catalysts were characterized by scanning electron microscope (SEM, Hitachi, S-4800).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern confirms successful synthesis of β-Ni(OH)₂/NF and β-Co₀.₁Ni₀.₉(OH)₂/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern shows that β-Ni(OH)₂/NF and β-Co₀.₁Ni₀.₉(OH)₂/NF were successfully synthesized (Figure S43).
